Anakin Skywalker'' |author=[[Todd Strasser]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[May]] [[1999]]''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]'' |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=112 |isbn=9780590520935 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[Star Wars Journal]]'' |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker''''', alternatively titled '''''Episode I Journal: Anakin Skywalker''''', is a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] middle-grade novel written by [[Todd Strasser]]. It is part of the ''[[Star Wars Journal]]'' series, and it was published in paperback by [[Scholastic]] in [[May]] [[1999]]. It is presented as an [[in-universe]] journal written by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and it recounts the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
